_about: The parks of the stack, in the order they must land (tools/preview/stack.mjs, docs/tools/preview.md). Tools keeps this file from each park's README: add a park here when its folder appears, move it when its order changes, set "ready": false while its owner says it is unfinished (it is left out unless --include-unready). Steps: patch (git apply of a file in the working tree), copy ({from, to}, "replace": true to take the park's file), overlay (working-tree folders an owner has not committed yet, laid over the commit; a folder that already equals the commit counts as landed), manual (a note; an apply script is never run). needs: {park}, {file}, {grep: {in, text}}, {note, owner} (a known gap that is not in the tree: it stays listed as missing until it is taken out of this file). switches: rows {id, file, path, from, to, needs, what} for flags a park adds that the stack should turn on.
